# Yuitility - Full Knowledge Base & Machine Index for AI Agents and LLMs
Site: https://www.yuitility.app
Architecture: 100% Client-Side WebAssembly and Native JavaScript (Zero Server Uploads)
Total Live Verified Tools: 132
Canonical Domain: https://www.yuitility.app

Yuitility is a universal web-based utility toolkit offering high-precision financial calculators, client-side PDF document manipulation, Canvas/WASM media processing, and offline developer utilities. All computations occur within the user's browser sandbox using local CPU memory. No user files, parameters, or payloads are transmitted to external servers.
